sections.title: Broadcasting fee and statutory municipal charges

rows.label: Tax status: UK Overseas Territory with its own tax system
rows.value: The Turks and Caicos Islands is a UK Overseas Territory with its own tax system, set by its own government and separate from the UK's. Its taxes are sales-type taxes administered by the Revenue Department (communications, domestic financial services, hotel and tourism, insurance premiums, vehicle hire), business licence fees, stamp duty and accommodation tax collected by the Ministry of Finance, and customs duties.

source.title: HM Treasury support for the UK Overseas Territories (April 2012)
HM Treasury support for the UK Overseas Territories (April 2012)

sections.note: Self-employed contributions, withholding on payments to freelancers and contractors, simplified regimes for small businesses, and expat and digital-nomad rules.
